requirement: Approved seamless-world design 4.3: persistent shared depletion, no refresh near players or with unclaimed loot.
change: Snapshots only read node state. Existing authoritative tick checks stored nodes at most every five seconds. Due empty nodes renew only outside every active public-world player/body's existing 45-unit node visibility radius. Renewal and original maxStock join the existing full checkpoint and per-entity undo; save failure restores both nodes and scan clock. No new timer, queue or schema.

regression.initialRed: All eight initial resource tests failed against the prior lazy-on-snapshot/action implementation.
regression.unitCoverage: 10 cases: read-only snapshots, rejected harvest/reconnect cannot refill, timing, exact radius, other players/instances, finite disconnected body, leftover loot, restart, failed-checkpoint same-clock retry/private commit preservation, 10000 future nodes skip definitions and extra full saves, unrelated shared event does not skip refresh, real partial-container final-take/second-cycle/replay conservation.
regression.implementationCorrection: An additional failing test exposed dirty ||= renewal short-circuit after drop expiry; renewal is now always evaluated on its scheduled pass.
regression.legacyTests: First full run: 515 pass, 2 exploration tests fail because they assumed camping refresh. Updated those tests to retain 1800000/3600000ms minimum deadlines and original rewards, assert camping rejection, then leave 46 units and run the next scheduled check before returning.
regression.negativeControl: Removing only observer protection from production source makes the real integration fail with stock3/respawnAt0 instead of stock0/respawnAt312000. Source restored in finally before final verification.

productionIntegration.environment: Actual production server.ts child process, unique OS-temp synthetic SQLite, real WebSockets/timers/WAL/FULL. Authority clock controlled for five-minute deadlines and movement budget; no native browser/FPS result. Real save never opened.
productionIntegration.node: world:-4:-2:node:0, authored tree, three stocks, 300-second original duration
productionIntegration.route: Starts (-123,-61), selected collision-free/quiet 48-unit path and exact reverse. Each real player_sync advances 1.5 units per controlled 500ms authority interval, within original 3.8-unit/s budget. No movement corrections during the walk.
productionIntegration.depletion: Three successful real gather actions award three wood. Persisted stock0 expires at312000. Remaining nearby at deadline and reconnecting both preserve depletion; attempted camped gather rejects and creates no handled entry.
productionIntegration.failureAndRenewal: SQLite trigger rejects world checkpoints during departure. Production tick reports failure without exiting; persisted node remains depleted and ping/health remain live. Removing trigger permits scheduled full checkpoint to store stock3/respawnAt0.
productionIntegration.returnAndRecovery: Real movement protocol walk returns to start. One gather awards fourth wood and leaves stock2. Replayed request does not pay again. Forced process stop and reload retain wood4, stock2, four unique successful IDs; integrity_check ok.
productionIntegration.qaCorrections: Initial fixture jumped authority time300s and hit the correct60s idle timeout; now advances <=30s with real pings. Next fixture mistakenly counted initial full-state correction as movement rejection; now waits for baseline and inspects only subsequent movement. Neither required a product workaround.

syntheticTickCost.method: Five fresh memory-DB worlds per case, no players or parallel tests/build; real nodeAt definitions for due resources. Measured entire first due tick including full checkpoint JSON when changed. Ignored helper data/measure-resource-renewal-20261023.ts.
syntheticTickCost.interpretation: Known synchronous burst at large simultaneous expiry. Not a passing native frame/latency/capacity gate; do not equate this microtest to whole-game performance.

verification.fullSuite: Final machine-readable Vitest report: success true, 38 files passed, 517 tests passed, zero failed/pending.
verification.build: npm run build passed; client index-BRl8LPRa.js unchanged. Existing Vite native-loader/chunk-size warnings remain.
verification.review: Independent read-only review and final exploration/container-test follow-up: no P1/P2; reviewer did not rerun tests/build.

remaining: Stored-node scan remains O(node count) once per five seconds; many due definitions and a shared checkpoint can stall the event loop. A budget/fairness/index design needs separate validation.
Busy observed public areas intentionally stay depleted; population pressure, starter availability and alternate exploration routes still need balance testing.
No new native visual/performance run; previous crowded-combat single refusal remains unresolved. This is not completion of the overall game objective.
